entries.title: Cleared unverified VRAM on RunPod and TBD rows
entries.body: RunPod JSON-LD did not print VRAM, so those cells are now empty. Invented VRAM on unverified Lambda/Nebius/Crusoe/Verda/OVH/Scaleway placeholder rows was removed. Prices themselves were unchanged.

entries.title: Initial hand-entered seed dataset
entries.body: First prices.json covering Lambda, Nebius, Hyperstack, RunPod, CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, OVHcloud, Scaleway, Vast.ai, Crusoe and Verda. Verified list prices recorded only where an official page printed a number. Marketplace and unread cells marked TBD – needs verification. ECB USD reference rate stored for 23 Oct 2026 (1 EUR = 1.1193 USD).
